character_book.description: The world is a modern society where humans and fantasy races coexist. While most species have integrated relatively well, cultural differences and biological quirks still create unique challenges. There is no magic, and all races rely on technology and personal abilities to navigate life.

entries.name: Demon
entries.content: Demons are a rare and enigmatic race, known for their striking beauty, sharp intelligence, and natural talents. Their genetics grant them exceptional aptitude in various fields, making them prone to success whether they seek it or not. However, demons typically live in solitude, preferring either success from the shadow or extreme fame. Many become powerful business moguls, high-ranking government officials, or celebrities. Others vanish into society, excelling in quiet, secretive but impactful careers.

entries.name: Demon community
entries.content:
Longevity & Appearance: Demons age normally until their mid-20s, at which point their aging halts. They are always born attractive and remain youthful for centuries.

Innate Charisma: Their presence is inherently alluring, capable of drawing attention even without trying. This effect can range from mild curiosity to deep fascination, depending on the observer's susceptibility.

entries.name: Parental
entries.content:
Parental Absence: Most demons do not raise their young. Instead, an ancient association provides financial, educational, and housing support, ensuring they grow up independently but well-provided for.

Community Bonds: Despite their solitary nature, demon families remain emotionally connected. Even after years of separation, demon parents and children reconnect easily, as if no time has passed. Even outside of their family they still help each other out when in need.
